title: Vibration Analysis (Internship at PT PLN Nusantara Power)
skills: Vibration Analysis, Troubleshooting, Root Cause Analysis, Technical Reporting
description: During my internship at PT PLN Nusantara Power UP Indramayu, a steam power generation company, I focused on analyzing a recurring issue of high vibration in the generator stator cooling water system pump. This critical machine impacts the power plant's production capacity (3x330 MW). My analysis involved field observation, literature review, data collection, data processing, problem diagnosis, and recommendation formulation. The investigation revealed that the high vibration was caused by looseness and misalignment due to damage on the motor baseplate. To mitigate this, I recommended replacing the baseplate, performing precise alignment, and installing epoxy grout to prevent fatigue failure from undamped vibrations. Note: Due to confidentiality, detailed documentation for this project is not available for public.

title: Design Optimization of Soft Robot Bionic Hand Manipulator using Supervised Machine Learning
skills: Soft Robotics, Machine Learning, Design Optimization, CAD, Research
description: Around 16% of the global population lives with disabilities, with hand amputation being a common cause. Bionic hands offer a solution, but traditional models made from rigid materials lack the flexibility of a human hand. To address this, the Biomechanics Research Team at ITB developed a soft robotic bionic hand using a combination of soft materials, a rigid structure, and strain limiters to mimic natural hand movement. Achieving a 90-degree range of motion is key to enhancing the hand's functionality. However, optimizing soft robot design is computationally intensive due to its complexity. To reduce this burden, machine learning was used to find optimal designs more efficiently. Algorithms such as linear regression, decision tree, random forest, k-nearest neighbors, and support vector machine (SVM) were tested using simulation-generated data. The decision tree model improved the index finger's range of motion by 16%, while the SVM model enhanced the thumb and little finger designs by 11% and 21%, respectively, compared to previous designs. As further improvement, I developed more robust model that has been deployed named Dextera AI, democratizing patient-specific soft robotic bionic hand for everyone.

title: Bulletproof Car Door Simulation (Finite Element Method)

This simulation provided crucial insights into material response, energy absorption capabilities, and ultimately, helped optimize the design for enhanced ballistic protection.

title: Drunk Driver Detector (Machine Learning)

title: Jumping Gait Kinematic Analysis (Biomechanics)

description: This project focused on a two-dimensional kinematic analysis of how different shoe types affect jumping height. Utilizing motion capture technology and analytical methods, the study investigated how various footwear designs influence biomechanical parameters during a jump. The goal was to understand and ultimately optimize jumping performance by identifying the key kinematic factors influenced by shoe characteristics.
